The absolute-trend gate has helped on HK history (gate_helps true), but cross-sectional momentum is rank-IC ~0 and rotation timing is display-only, so this is a durability/risk-control read, not a return forecast. Note: the head of this desk has an unusually strong track record (23/24) but only 24 graded calls — treat conviction as calibrated to a well-scored but small sample.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners (rank 2, score 1.23, hurst_tag trend) crosses the eligibility gate AND its durability_bar rises above ~0.35-0.40 AND breadth (currently 0.0) turns positive — that combination would retire the watch and signal a confirmed handoff from Banks to a resources-led leadership.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks hold rank 1, are the only eligible leader with the strongest durability_bar (0.59) and positive breadth (0.538). The trend gate on HK history has historically reduced drawdown/tail even when it does not add return — meaning staying-power is the one validated leg, and Banks are the only leader still eligible with healthy durability. However, the hurst_tag is mean-revert (not trend) and no ETF proxy exists, so this is a qualitative lean on defensive leadership, not a momentum call.
theses.dissent: Banks' hurst_tag is mean-revert, so the leadership could just be a defensive tilt rolling over, and the margin over challenger Diversified Miners (1.23, ineligible) is thin — a handoff to miners or a broad reversal would pull the leader down with it.

theses.thesis: High-Dividend Blue Chips are eligible (true) with the second-strongest durability_bar (0.57) in the eligible set and a trend hurst_tag — the closest thing to a legitimate trend-following eligible theme. theses.dissent: Breadth is thin (0.25) — only a quarter of constituents confirming — so this could be a single-name or narrow income bid masking as a theme, and the adjacent Telecom & Utilities (rank 9, ineligible) is NOT confirming.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet (3033.HK, scorable) is ineligible (false), rank 13 with negative score (-0.635) and a very weak durability_bar (0.18) with mean-revert hurst_tag. The trend gate that has historically helped HK does NOT currently include this theme, and platform megacaps (same proxy) are rank 15. The detector permits naming the prevailing weak side as a non-confirmed laggard, not as a short — this is an avoid/decrease lean on an unconfirmed, weak-trend area.
theses.dissent: The absolute-trend gate removes themes to avoid regime chop — removing this one from the eligible set could be a false-negative; if HK rotates into growth or a rebound catches China tech, exclusion becomes a miss.
